name: Ibero Mining Corp.
summary: Goldplay Mining Inc., a Vancouver, Canada-based enterprise, specializes in the procurement and geological investigation of various mineral assets. The company's main focus is on identifying and developing deposits rich in gold, silver, and copper. Its current portfolio encompasses a 70% option agreement for the Scottie West gold project, strategically located in British Columbia's northwestern Golden Triangle. In Portugal, Goldplay Mining holds full 100% ownership of the Borba 2 projects. Additionally, it maintains 100% stakes in the Big Frank and Goldstorm South properties, both situated in the western Chilcotin District of southwestern British Columbia. The company is also actively working to acquire a 100% equity interest in the Barrancos properties, positioned in south-central Portugal. Founded in 2017, the organization was originally known as Industria Metals Inc. before officially changing its name to Goldplay Mining Inc. in November 2020.
